# Steady 2.21.15

## What's new
- **Websites work with Steady VPN on** — root cause: DNS-only VPN was blocking all IPv6, and Device Owner “lockdown” mode blackholed HTTPS that wasn’t inside the tiny DNS route. GitHub Pages + `*.less-phone.workers.dev` are dual-stack, so they failed while the VPN looked fine.
- **Fixes:** allow IPv6 fallthrough on the tunnel; Always-On VPN without lockdown (DNS filter still always-on; kids still can’t remove VPN via Settings); Steady hosts resolve via plain Cloudflare `1.1.1.1`; tunnel rebuilds once after update.

## For parents
Update the kid phone, open Steady once (VPN rebuilds), then try:
- https://labratkali.github.io/steady-web/
- https://steady.less-phone.workers.dev/
- https://steady.less-phone.workers.dev/testing/
